events.content:
Added a Server Action in [app/actions.ts](/vercel/sandbox/app/actions.ts#L1) that flips the notification preference and then calls `refresh()` from `next/cache`, which is Next.js’s in-action way to refresh the current route without redirecting. In this minimal repo, the preference is stored in an HTTP-only cookie.

Updated [app/page.tsx](/vercel/sandbox/app/page.tsx#L1) to read the current preference from cookies on the server, show the current on/off state, and submit a `<form action={toggleNotificationPreference}>` so the page re-renders in place after the toggle.

`npm run build` passes. During that build, Next.js also auto-updated [tsconfig.json](/vercel/sandbox/tsconfig.json#L31) to include `.next/dev/types/**/*.ts`.
